_comment: Test files under tests/ that no CI step runs, each with a one-line reason. Checked by scripts/verify/check-test-coverage.mjs (CI step 'Check every test file is run once or excluded'); the same files are skipped by `npm test` so local and CI run the same set. Categories: needs browser, needs network, needs live auth, long soak, local fixture, fails on main.

tests/analysis/live-auth-persistence-soa.reason: launches Playwright Chromium against a loopback server; the browser is only installed later in the Verify job

tests/ui/dom-settings-primitives.test.ts.reason: launches Playwright Chromium to measure real layout; the browser is only installed later in the Verify job

tests/maze/maze-soak.test.ts.reason: fails on main: AssertionError: expected false to be true (tests/maze/maze-soak.test.ts:181, heap-band check; also a soak, run by npm run test:soak)

tests/playbook-adoption-evidence.test.mj.reason: fails on main: ENOENT reading playbook/exports/playbook.contract.example.v1.json (reads a sibling local Playbook checkout)

tests/playbook-verification-report.test..reason: fails on main: ENOENT reading schemas/atlas.playbook.verification.report.v1.json (reads a local ATLAS schemas folder)

tests/reset/legacy-reset.test.ts.reason: read the local-only mazer-legacy-unreal-restore C++ source tree (21 MB of legacy project source, not committed); skipped by name in the CI tests/reset step, run locally under npm test
names: resumes from the next tile selected during legacy backtracking
defers overlay rebuild travel until closing the options surface
routes pause commands through an explicit legacy pause lifecycle contract
routes menu-time overlay field commits through an explicit legacy flag contract
